notes: The fridge clip in Ali's Noah timelines is fridge-disc-swap-celine-FINAL.mp4 (hence products/celine-dion in media_dirs).
rules: Normal edit: only the hook changes (sometimes the rehook). Body, end clip, caption style and song placement come from the template.

Hook longer or shorter than the template: the tool ripples the timeline. Body and CTA move, the hook caption stretches, the song starts earlier (music box, handoff fixed) or runs longer (no end sound).
Store-claim hooks (RUN to <STORE>, <BRAND> x <STORE>, '<STORE> just collabed') pair with the reveal CTA (JK / Just JOKING / Je rigole). Every other hook pairs with the plain CTA.
Use the store the hook clip actually shows (TARGET / WALMART / COSTCO / LECLERC / CARREFOUR).
workflow: Same as Celine (Ali, 2026-10-08): each timeline in CapCut project 'Noah Kahan' is named after its song and holds that song cut to the right section. Picking the song = picking the timeline. Swap the hook (new clip at normal speed; an old hook cut into pieces is replaced as one) and set the caption style. Body clips never change. Shorter hook: cut the start of the song and caption, slide left. Longer hook: extend song and caption at the start.
mix: Keep each song timeline exactly as Ali mixed it. The 10.9 dB raw rule only applies to library song swaps.
